brief: Create an editable phone screen daily-notes titled Daily notes, 390 by 844, for a calm walking journal. Read the project kit first. If missing, save the default project kit with title Fieldnotes, colors paper #f6f4ef, ink #16261f, accent #27634b, textStyles title {fontSize:34,fontWeight:700} and body {fontSize:17,fontWeight:400}, spacing md 16 and sm 8, radii button 12. Pin that exact kit on the screen. Include heading text A quieter day, subtitle text One step at a time, meaningful real content and two linked button instances with distinct labels Start a walk and View history via componentProperties/componentValues. Give the title layer id heading and subtitle layer id subtitle. Use bound typography and spacing. Inspect the returned image and fix clipped text, overflow and low contrast before replying. Preserve this identity. Use design tools only, no HTML, research or other apps. The bundled design skill is available; read it if needed. Do not use extra process skills. Reply in one short sentence. Enable consistency.mode strict from the first save. Do not add exceptions, change the kit, or disable strict mode. Use only the declared palette, typography, spacing and radii. Prefer hug text and automatic vertical layout.
